chunks: About a man—whether it is permissible for him to perform tawaf on behalf of his relatives. He said: “When he has completed the rites of hajj, then let him do whatever he wishes.”

key_terms.يَطُوفَ: to perform tawaf, circumambulating the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: Can a person perform tawaf on behalf of his relatives after completing his own hajj rites?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing tawaf on behalf of one’s relatives. It indicates that after a person has completed the rites of hajj for himself, he may then perform tawaf on behalf of others.
